stories.headline: Melvor Idle 2: A RuneScape Adventure begins Early Access on November 17
stories.summary: The RuneScape-inspired idle sequel is scheduled to enter Steam Early Access around 11:00 today. Its newly published launch notes detail Astrology, Herblore and Agility skills, 1,138 extra items, 121 new enemies, four Mastery Guild ranks and the second act of quests. Demo saves carry over to Early Access.

stories.headline: Deep Rock Galactic: Survivor - Knockout Expansion arrives November 17
stories.summary: Ghost Ship Publishing and Funday Games are launching their second paid expansion for Deep Rock Galactic: Survivor today. It adds the fist-fighting Brawler class, the Sandblasted Corridors biome and a Brood Harvest mission featuring the Dreadnought Empress. The publisher also plans a free companion update.

game.name: Deep Rock Galactic: Survivor - Knockout Expansion

steamPages.name: Deep Rock Galactic: Survivor - Knockout Expansion

stories.headline: Crusader Kings III: Silk & Silver brings merchant companies and republics today
stories.summary: Paradox's major expansion is scheduled for November 17. Players can establish and grow merchant companies, manage trade and compete for political influence as republican patrician families in locations such as Venice and Genoa. The DLC requires Crusader Kings III.

stories.headline: Disney Dreamlight Valley: The Keepsake Sea patch notes reveal underwater adventures
stories.summary: Gameloft has detailed the November 18 expansion ahead of launch. Players will unlock a customizable Merfolk form, explore three new island biomes, meet characters including Jack Sparrow and Dory, and use a customizable pirate ship. A free base-game patch brings fixes, while partner-stream Twitch Drops run November 18 through December 2.

steamPages.name: Disney Dreamlight Valley: The Keepsake Sea

stories.headline: Ranger’s Path: National Park Simulator targets 1.0 release with two-player co-op
stories.summary: Astragon plans to bring the park-ranger sim out of Steam Early Access on November 17. Its full launch adds optional two-player cooperative play with cross-platform support as it also debuts on consoles. Players patrol trails, support visitors and rescue wildlife in Faremont National Park.

stories.headline: Burning Sword: Death Sun prepares its November 17 Early Access debut
stories.summary: Nomadic Games' wuxia action adventure is scheduled to start Steam Early Access today. Set in 1139 during China's Southern Song dynasty, it follows Zhang Yixiang through punishing martial-arts duels, agile traversal, boss battles and an arena mode. Its developers say additional chapters will arrive during Early Access.

stories.headline: Space Station Designer sets November 18 PC launch
stories.summary: Polar Motion and Slitherine are preparing a space-station construction and management simulator for release tomorrow. The game asks players to design orbital outposts, manage astronauts and logistics, expand across Earth and lunar orbits, and ultimately build a lunar space elevator.

stories.headline: Littlelands enters Steam Early Access with cozy exploration and mysteries
stories.summary: Apogee Entertainment's colorful miniature-world adventure entered Steam Early Access on November 16. Players explore a lively region, gather and grow resources, meet eccentric residents and seek out hidden treasures and secrets. It is available now rather than merely listed as an upcoming release.

stories.headline: Milki Delivery pedals toward its November 17 Steam release
stories.summary: The short, mouse-playable countryside adventure is scheduled to launch today. As young courier Neha, players deliver bottles of milk by bicycle, collect resources for their cow Milki, upgrade a barn and take on small quests for nearby residents. A Steam demo is already available.
